resources.string: When another keyboard pops up, shows a small mic above it; one tap switches the current field to the voice orb. When the Tasker plugin starts recognition, it also checks whether you\'re in a text field and switches the keyboard here. It only looks at keyboard windows appearing or disappearing and whether the focus is a text field — it doesn\'t read the text on screen or intercept keys.
Enable this keyboard in the system
Opens the system\'s keyboard settings; turn on “Wotingbudong”
Switch button in the navigation bar

With the accessibility service on, assign the system\'s accessibility button to “Wotingbudong · quick switch”: a button appears in the navigation bar that switches between Wotingbudong and your previous keyboard. Tap here to set it up.
Show a small microphone above other keyboards
Needs the accessibility service. Off by default; the navigation-bar button is handier
The service\'s API URL; filled in automatically when you pick a provider. For Shuohuaa, use the “Phone API” line of ./shuohuaa status on the computer, e.g. http://100.x.y.z:9797
The provider\'s API key; for Shuohuaa, SHUOHUAA_API_TOKEN from the computer\'s .env (leave empty if not set)
Checks whether the main and fallback services are reachable and the API keys work
Streams the phone\'s microphone to the computer, where it can be chosen as the audio source (e.g. when you use the computer remotely). Stays connected; mute or stop from the notification
While muted the microphone is off and nothing is sent; the connection stays open
Fallback service (used when the main one is unreachable, optional)
Same as for the main service; empty = no fallback
Hold longer than this for push-to-talk (ms)
Safety net for long uninterrupted speech: when reached, the segment is cut at the nearest quiet moment and typed. Lower = faster feedback, more requests
Stop recording after this much silence (s)
In case you forget to stop. 0 = record until you stop it
The small buttons scale with it
Distance from the screen edge when docked (dp)
Increase it if you keep triggering edge gestures; the back-gesture zone is about 24
Start recording when switching to this keyboard
No need to tap the orb
Hand back to your keyboard when a field reopens
If this keyboard is still selected when you next open a text field, switch back to your usual keyboard automatically
On: the navigation-bar accessibility button, the small mic above other keyboards and the Tasker plugin can switch here. Flip to turn off
Off. Flipping it opens system settings — turn on “Wotingbudong · Quick switch” there. Samsung phones first need “Allow restricted settings” in App info
Not granted — tap to grant (needed for recording)
No microphone permission, tap the gear to grant it
Nobody spoke for a while, stopped
Main service unreachable — this sentence used the fallback
The text before the cursor has changed, nothing deleted
Switching back to the keyboard after this sentence
Use the keyboard for password and number fields
Don\'t type \'uh\', \'um\' and similar. A meaningful \'mm-hm\' is removed too
Neither the main nor the fallback service can be reached: %1$s
No recognition service set yet (Settings → Recognition service)
Can\'t reach the computer (%1$s), retrying in %2$d s
Turn off when the computer hasn\'t used it for (min)
The computer decides: if it hasn\'t recorded from the phone mic for this long, the phone turns it off. Background sound doesn\'t matter. Also counts while not connected. 0 = never
PC microphone: turned off after %1$d minutes unused
Phone microphone: can\'t reach the computer
PC microphone can\'t reach the computer: %1$s. Retrying automatically
connection timed out; check the network between the phone and the computer
the computer isn\'t listening; is the Shuohuaa service running?
Not in a text field. Press again to record on the computer with the phone as mic
Tap to turn on the PC microphone and start recording on the computer
Phone microphone: the computer is recording
No computer address set for microphone mode
Phone microphone: paused during voice input
Phone microphone: streaming to the computer
Filled in with the provider\'s default model; you can change it. Not needed for Shuohuaa (it uses the computer\'s current model). Empty = whisper-1
The computer running Shuohuaa, e.g. 100.x.y.z (the “Phone microphone” line of ./shuohuaa status)
SHUOHUAA_API_TOKEN from that computer\'s .env; leave empty if not set
Live text sends the recording for recognition every 0.7 s while you speak — with a pay-per-request cloud service that means many more requests
Turn on Quick switch in Settings to switch here from another keyboard
Switching keyboards needs Android 11 or later
Couldn\'t switch: enable the Wotingbudong keyboard in system settings first
Toggle (stop if running, start if not)
This Tasker action is no longer valid — reopen it in Tasker
Only this page; you can undo it
Everything on this page goes back to its default. You can undo it for a few seconds afterwards.
Tap to turn it on so Tasker can switch here from another keyboard
